column2: HMIS Item-wise Monthly Report aggregates health management information system (HMIS) reporting items at the sub-district level for West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh, for {period}. It supports monitoring service delivery, tracking monthly progress, and compiling provisional performance for public health planning. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, updated monthly with data granularity at the sub-district level.

The dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in West Tripura, Tripura, for {period}. It supports monitoring of health service delivery across public and private facilities, including rural and urban breakouts. Published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, it is updated on a monthly basis with provisional figures where applicable.

An HMIS monthly reporting dataset covering health system indicators reported at the sub-district level for Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, Telangana, for {period}. It compiles item-wise performance of public and private facilities (rural and urban facilities). The dataset supports monitoring, program review, and trend analysis of service delivery under the National Health Mission framework.

Monthly HMIS Item-wise reporting data for sub-districts in Yavatmal, Maharashtra, covering {period}. It supports monitoring of public and private service availability and related items through provisional figures. Sourced from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

Monthly performance data for operation major (general and spinal anaesthesia) across public facilities, for {period}. It focuses on districts that have shifted to facility-wise data uploading on the HMIS portal, excluding medical colleges. The dataset covers facility reporting and nil-performance handling for operational indicators, with data compiled at range-wise level based on facility activity during the reporting period.

Monthly, district-level performance of AYUSH public facilities focused on outpatient attendance, aggregated and reported by range, for {period}. It supports monitoring service utilization, facility reporting coverage, and comparative performance across administrative ranges. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, reflecting HMIS portal facility-wise uploads for selected districts.
